configuration.title: Mutsumi
configuration.providers.items.name.markd: LLM API Provider Name (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, llama.cpp)
configuration.providers.items.api_key.ma: LLM API Key (required, use dummy value for local deployments without authentication)
configuration.models.markdownDescription:
Model to provider name mapping. Key is model identifier, value is the provider name from mutsumi.providers

Example:
```json
"mutsumi.models": {
    "kimi-for-coding": "kimi-for-coding"
}
```
configuration.defaultModel.markdownDescr: Default model to use (must be a key in mutsumi.models)
configuration.titleGeneratorModel.markdo: Model used for generating agent titles (must be a key in mutsumi.models)
configuration.autoApproveEnabled.descrip: When enabled, all tool calls will be automatically approved without user confirmation (use with caution)
configuration.compressModel.markdownDesc: Model used for compressing conversations (must be a key in mutsumi.models). If empty, falls back to titleGeneratorModel then defaultModel
configuration.embeddingEndpoint.descript: OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint URL (e.g., http://localhost:1234/v1/embeddings). If empty, RAG features will be disabled.
configuration.shellSyncTimeout.descripti: Seconds a synchronous (non-background) shell call may run before being auto-detached to background. Set 0 to disable auto-detach.
configuration.httpServer.enabled.descrip: Enable the Mutsumi HTTP Server (disabled by default). All endpoints require Bearer token authentication when enabled.
configuration.httpServer.password.descri: Bearer token password for the Mutsumi HTTP Server. Stored in PLAINTEXT in settings. If empty while the server is enabled, the server refuses to start. Use the 'Mutsumi: Generate HTTP Server Password' command to create one.
configuration.httpServer.host.descriptio: Address the HTTP Server binds to. WARNING: changing this to 0.0.0.0 exposes the server to your LAN or the public internet — set a strong password (mutsumi.httpServer.password) first.
configuration.httpServer.port.descriptio: Starting port for the HTTP Server. If occupied, subsequent ports are scanned (up to +100).
